caption: The drawing depicts two wooden containers placed against a plain, off-white background. The container on the left is an open-top box with sides that curve upward and then slope back down, featuring a small round hole near the top edge of one side, possibly for gripping. It is rectangular with visible wood grain texture and is colored in a reddish-brown hue. The container on the right is a taller, trapezoidal bin with a hinged section near its lower half, suggesting a compartment that can be accessed separately. This container has a square top and tapers inward before widening again near the bottom. Both containers display the same reddish-brown color and wood grain detail. The overall composition shows the containers positioned close to each other on a neutral, uncluttered background.
title: Shaker Wood Box and Kindling Box
